name: FreeCAD
description: Create, inspect and edit parametric 3D models with FreeCAD (free, open source) and export STEP and STL files. Works through FreeCAD's own command-line program without opening a window.

requirements.text: FreeCAD 0.21 or newer must be installed (free from freecad.org). Its FreeCADCmd.exe program is used, so FreeCAD does not need to be open.
Files stay inside this project's FreeCAD work folder: existing FreeCAD files from elsewhere must be copied there first. New work is always saved as new files; nothing is overwritten.
Tested against FreeCAD 1.1.4 on Windows. Other FreeCAD versions in the supported range (0.21 and newer) have not been tested.

dependencies.name: FreeCAD (with FreeCADCmd.exe)
dependencies.note: FreeCAD brings its own Python; nothing else to install.

commands.label: Check that FreeCAD can model
commands.description: Starts FreeCAD without a window, builds a 10 mm cube in a temporary document and measures it. Saves nothing.

commands.label: Create a parametric 3D model
commands.description: Makes a new FreeCAD project (.FCStd) whose dimensions come from a named-parameter spreadsheet, so they can be changed later with "Change a model parameter". Shapes: box, cylinder, or plate_with_hole (a plate with a centred through-hole). Dimensions are in millimetres. The saved file is re-opened and its volume checked.

name.description: File name of the new project, without extension.

hole_diameter.description: Hole diameter in mm (plate_with_hole); must be smaller than the length and width.

commands.label: Inspect a FreeCAD document
commands.description: Lists the objects, named parameters, expressions, volumes and bounding boxes of a project. Changes nothing.

document.description: The FreeCAD document in this project's FreeCAD work folder, for example "Bracket.FCStd".

commands.label: Add a basic 3D shape
commands.description: Adds a box, cylinder, sphere or cone to an existing project and saves the result as a NEW file (the original is kept). Dimensions in mm; x, y, z place it.

document.description: The FreeCAD document in this project's FreeCAD work folder, for example "Bracket.FCStd".

label.description: Name shown for the new shape.

radius.description: Radius in mm (cylinder, sphere, cone base).

output.description: Name for the new file (no extension). It is always a NEW file; existing files are never overwritten. Default: the document name plus " edited".

commands.label: Change an object property
commands.description: Sets one supported property of one object (Length, Width, Height, Radius, Radius1, Radius2, Angle, Label, Placement.Base.x/y/z) and saves a NEW file. Properties driven by a parameter must be changed with "Change a model parameter".

document.description: The FreeCAD document in this project's FreeCAD work folder, for example "Bracket.FCStd".

object.description: Object name as listed by the inspect command, for example Box.

value.description: New value: a number in mm (degrees for Angle) or the new label.

output.description: Name for the new file (no extension). It is always a NEW file; existing files are never overwritten. Default: the document name plus " edited".

commands.label: Change a model parameter
commands.description: Changes one named parameter of a model made with "Create a parametric 3D model" (for example length). Every dependent shape is recomputed; the result is saved as a NEW file.

document.description: The FreeCAD document in this project's FreeCAD work folder, for example "Bracket.FCStd".

name.description: Parameter name, for example length, width, height, radius or hole_diameter.

output.description: Name for the new file (no extension). It is always a NEW file; existing files are never overwritten. Default: the document name plus " edited".

commands.label: Save a copy of a FreeCAD project
commands.description: Saves a copy of a project under a new name (native .FCStd) and checks that it reopens with the same objects.

document.description: The FreeCAD document in this project's FreeCAD work folder, for example "Bracket.FCStd".

output.description: Name of the copy, without extension.

commands.label: Export STEP
commands.description: Exports the solids of a project (or one object) to a STEP file, then reads the STEP file back and compares the volume with the model.

document.description: The FreeCAD document in this project's FreeCAD work folder, for example "Bracket.FCStd".

output.description: File name without extension. Default: the document name.

commands.label: Export STL
commands.description: Exports the solids of a project (or one object) to an STL mesh, then reads it back and compares triangle count and volume with the model.

document.description: The FreeCAD document in this project's FreeCAD work folder, for example "Bracket.FCStd".

output.description: File name without extension. Default: the document name.

tolerance_mm.description: Mesh accuracy in mm: smaller is finer and slower.
